title: Design: Picking an original work order shows the Original technician line
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a regular customer (not flagged), with one asset.
  • Have an invoiced work order of the regular customer with one line done by a technician, made for this test.
  • Start on New Work Order with the regular customer picked, No Charge ticked and Warranty picked.
  • Open the attached pictures iwo-flow1-07-02e-new-work-order-no-charge-ticked.png, iwo-flow2-04-02-confirm.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Pick the invoiced work order in Original work order.
  2. Pick its line in Original line.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The optional select "Original line" appears, listing that work order's lines (number, title, technician).
  • The line "Original technician: [names]" shows under the selects.

Step 2:

  • The Original technician line names the technician of that line.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-R2: “once a work order is picked, the optional select "Original line" lists its lines (number, title, technician).”
  • S2-R2: “As soon as a work order or a line is picked, the line "Original technician: [names]" (or "Original technician: none") shows under the selects, so a wrong attribution is seen and corrected by picking the line before anything is saved.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: pages "Flow 1 · Create and close" / "Flow 2 · No charge on a customer's work order", boards "02e New work order · No Charge ticked" (Flow 1 · Create and close), "02 Confirm" (Flow 2 · No charge on a customer's work order).
